correctness.rationale: For synchronous tie-retaining strict-neighbor-majority on C_n with one leaf, symmetric integer W with diagonal tie-retention loops makes all local fields odd and nonzero; the two-time Lyapunov pairing increases strictly unless s(t+1)=s(t-1), establishing eventual period at most two for all n>=3. A flip at any degree-two rim vertex forces neighbors to flip; propagation yields the all-flip alternating even-n orbit. Otherwise only root/leaf flip with endpoints opposite and all interior constant runs length >=2. Opposite endpoints imply an even number of runs, giving generating function 2R(z)^2/(1-R(z)^2), R=z²/(1-z), coefficient F_{n-2}-q_{n-3}; add one even-n alternating orbit. Fixed states require no singleton runs, counted by trace of four-state transfer matrix with char polynomial (lambda²-lambda-1)(lambda²-lambda+1), hence H=L_n+2cos(pi n/3). Independently enumerated all states at n=3,...,10 and agreed with both formulas (H,N): (2,0),(6,1),(12,2),(20,5),(30,6),(46,9),(74,12),(122,21). The finite check corroborates the all-n proof.
